Explain the concrete problem and how this change affects users.

## Validation

List the checks run and any relevant limitations.

- [ ] Documentation and changelog match user-visible changes.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; code/configuration changes pass `make check`.
- [ ] Fixtures and attachments contain no private receiver data or credentials.
- [ ] Third-party material retains its source attribution and terms.

For contract, SDK, or storage changes, describe compatibility, retries, identity,
and recovery behavior.
